Temple Architectural Documentation Lab

A half-day workshop, online or at your venue

On request

Arranged for your group. Send your preferred dates, group size and location. We adapt the length, level and language, and prepare a quotation. The suggested group size is a guide, not a requirement.

Request on WhatsApp Request by email

No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

In this workshop you produce a plan/elevation and photographic building record.

All materials are provided. The session is adapted to your space, your timetable and the age of the participants.

What it covers

  • Field drawing protocol
  • Observed description
  • Peer review

How the time is spent

  1. Field drawing protocol 35 min

    Scale, vantage and photographic reference.

    You: prepare sheet

  2. Observed description 110 min

    Measure only safe, accessible features.

    You: measured-sketch draft

  3. Peer review 35 min

    Separate observation from reconstruction.

    You: final annotated sheet

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

You take away

An activity sheet to keep.
